original.reason: It does not establish that 1 is not in (1+i), so it has not shown the two listed cosets are distinct or that the quotient has order 2.

judgment.reason: It asserts without justification that 1 is not in (1+i); this is needed to prove there are exactly two cosets.
The essential assertion 1 notin (1+i) is stated but not proved, leaving the distinctness of the two cosets unsupported.
It correctly classifies the cosets, proves they are distinct by showing 1 is not in the ideal, and establishes that the sole nonzero quotient element is invertible.
It does not prove the necessary direction of the stated divisibility equivalence, and it asserts without proof that 1 is not in (1+i), which is needed for distinct cosets.
